scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @appsolo/shared build && pnpm --filter @appsolo/database build && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "pnpm --filter @appsolo/api dev" "pnpm --filter @appsolo/web dev"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @appsolo/shared build && pnpm --filter @appsolo/database build && pnpm --filter @appsolo/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @appsolo/web typecheck
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm --filter @appsolo/database test:prepare && pnpm --filter @appsolo/shared build && pnpm --filter @appsolo/database build && playwright test -c e2e/playwright.config.ts
